summary: Reuse inert storage-audit pages in the strict kit play gate without changing its timing budget or coverage

replay.detail: Only the Storybook CI harness changes; no runtime replay behavior changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, migration, index, or trigger changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated member upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: No application client, protocol, pairing, or provider admission changes. The CI harness keeps its existing case and storage-isolation requirements.

downtime.detail: No deployed service changes or additional interruption.

manual.detail: Existing installations require no action; the change only reduces repeated browser-audit setup in CI.

recovery.detail: No runtime recovery or swap-back changes; persistent installation state is untouched.
